fields.h1: Build a Stay Interview Form That Turns Answers Into Actions
fields.hero_description: Build a stay interview form that saves each conversation and tracks every follow-up action until it is done.
fields.features_heading: What the Manager Needs in the Room and After
fields.features_subheading: A stay interview form guides one conversation with one employee, then keeps what the manager promised in view until it is done.
fields.feature_1:
Five questions, same wording every time

The manager asks what keeps someone here, what might make them leave, what they would change, what they want to learn next, and what the manager should do differently.
fields.feature_2:
One theme on the answer about leaving

Tag that answer as pay, schedule, growth, or workload, one theme per interview. Across a quarter, the tags add up to counts HR can read without opening a single record.
fields.feature_3:
Promises saved with an owner and a date

Anything the manager agrees to look into becomes an action before the form is saved. Open actions stay on a list sorted by due date, and closed ones keep the date they closed.
fields.feature_4:
A reminder before each new hire hits day 90

The app emails the manager 7 days before a new hire's 90th day, with the stay interview form linked. Start dates come straight from the staff table, and nobody keeps a calendar.
fields.feature_5:
Records in a database you own

Each interview is a row with the employee, the manager, the date, and the five answers. Connect it to your HR system through its API, or query the table yourself when HR asks.
fields.feature_6:
Code export for an existing HR stack

On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository and run the stay interview app next to your HR tools. Host it where you choose and keep building on it from there.
fields.why_title: Why Build Stay Interview Forms With Emergent?
fields.why_description: A notes document holds what an employee said. It cannot chase the course a manager promised, or count how many people named pay.

fields.tab_content_1:
Rotating nights get an owner who follows up

Abeni Cassar supervises the night crew at Dunmarra Logistics and runs each stay interview from a tablet on the dock. Forklift operator Kellan Moss said rotating nights might make him leave. She tagged that answer Schedule and saved an action to ask operations about a fixed day shift, owned by her and due Nov 25.
fields.tab_content_2:
On day 83, a reminder reaches the branch manager

Every new teller at Ledgemoor Credit Union gets a stay interview on day 90. The app reads each start date from the staff table and emails the branch manager 7 days ahead. Thea Corlett got hers for Juno Oyelowo on day 83, with the form already showing his name, role, and start date.
fields.tab_content_3:
Past its due date, an open action reaches HR

Bram Kessel, a general manager at Stellwick Inns, promised front desk agent Lark Kimbrough a seat in a revenue management course by Oct 30. The date passed with the action still open. Any action open after its due date goes by email to Odile Vasko, the HR partner, with the owner and the employee named.
fields.tab_content_4:
Pay leads every theme at 23 of 64

Okeby Schools ran 64 stay interviews with support staff across 9 schools this fall. Each answer about leaving carries one theme, and the HR dashboard counts them. Pay came first with 23, then growth at 17, schedule at 14, and workload at 10. HR took the pay count to the January budget meeting.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Stay Interview Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to create a stay interview form that records each conversation and keeps every promised action moving until it closes.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Have the direct manager run it
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Freeze the wording of five questions
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Choose the themes you will count
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Turn every promise into an action
fields.howto_step_1_des: Have the employee's direct manager hold the conversation one on one, since that manager is the person who can act on the answers. Book it on its own date. SHRM advises that stay interviews should not be add-ons to performance-appraisal meetings.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Write the five questions once and read them the same way in every interview. Fixed wording lets answers from the night crew and the front office sit side by side. Keep each question open, and leave rating scales for a separate survey.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Pick four themes for the answer about leaving: pay, schedule, growth, and workload. Keep the list short enough to tag during the meeting. Add a fifth theme only after a quarter of answers that fit none of the four.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Anything the manager offers to look into gets an owner and a due date before the form is saved. Keep each action small enough to close within a month, such as asking about a shift change or booking a course.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Put the questions and themes into one prompt, along with the action fields. Emergent builds the stay interview form and the database behind it, plus the action list managers work from. Change a question later by asking in plain English.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Set reminders and the overdue rule
fields.howto_step_6_des: Ask for a heads-up email 7 days ahead of every new hire's day 90 interview, and a yearly reminder for everyone else. Then add the rule that sends any action still open after its due date to the HR partner.
fields.howto_step_7_des: Interview a colleague with the form before managers start, tag the answer about leaving, and save one action due the next day. Check that it shows on the action list, then let it go overdue and confirm the HR email arrives.

faq_plan.q: What is a stay interview form?
faq_plan.a: A stay interview form is the guide and the record for a stay interview, which SHRM defines as a structured discussion a leader conducts with an individual employee. It holds the questions the manager asks and the employee's answers, along with any action the manager agrees to take.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a stay interview form?
faq_plan.a: Settle the questions, the themes you will tag, and who owns follow-up actions. Then describe all of it to Emergent's AI form builder, which builds the form and a database that keeps every interview. Interview one colleague as a test before managers begin.

faq_plan.q: What should a stay interview form template include?
faq_plan.a: A stay interview form template needs a header naming the employee and the manager, with role and start date, then five open questions. Below the answers, add a theme tag for the answer about leaving, then an action field with its owner and due date. Emergent builds that layout from a plain-English description.

faq_plan.q: Where does a safety problem raised on a stay interview form go?
faq_plan.a: It goes on its own record, outside the interview. Log the hazard on an incident report form so the safety lead sees it and it follows its own process. In the stay interview record, note only that a report was filed, and keep the conversation on the job itself.

faq_plan.q: How many questions should a stay interview form have?
faq_plan.a: Five open questions fit a 20-minute meeting with time left to follow up on each answer. Keep the same five for every employee so answers compare across teams, and put any follow-up probes in the manager's notes instead of adding questions.

faq_plan.q: How often should managers fill out a stay interview form?
faq_plan.a: Once a year for each employee is a workable rhythm, plus one at day 90 for every new hire. Spread them across the year instead of holding them all in one week. Forms Emergent builds carry no response caps, and one program can cover every employee.

faq_plan.q: How do you track follow-up actions from a stay interview form?
faq_plan.a: Put a named owner and a deadline on each action, and keep them all on one list sorted by deadline. When the action is a course, send the employee to a training request form so it goes through the usual approval. Mark the action done once the course is booked.

faq_plan.q: Should a stay interview form be anonymous?
faq_plan.a: No. A stay interview is a one-on-one conversation between a manager and one employee, and the record names both of them. Collect anonymous views in a separate survey, and keep the two sets of results apart.

faq_plan.q: Who should be able to see the answers on a stay interview form?
faq_plan.a: Limit individual answers to the employee's manager and the HR partner. Build the HR dashboard to show theme counts across teams instead of single interviews, and keep every record in a database you own.

faq_plan.q: Should a stay interview form ask for personal details?
faq_plan.a: Ask only for the basics: name, role, manager, and start date. Home addresses and next of kin belong on an emergency contact form that HR keeps current. Leaving them off keeps the stay interview form short and the meeting about the job.

plan.angle: Stay interview results are question lists and printable templates that end when the meeting ends. This page treats the stay interview form as the record of a manager-led conversation: five fixed questions, one theme tag on the answer about leaving, and every promise saved as an action with an owner and a due date, then reminders and theme counts across teams. It stays clear of exit interviews, anonymous surveys and performance reviews.
